notes.title: The Obscura Soundtrack is now available for purchase on Steam!
notes.content:
[h1]Support the developers by purchasing the soundtrack![/h1]

We're excited to announce the the OST for Obscura is now available for purchase. This is likely the last announcement for awhile, but we hope that you've enjoyed Obscura as much as we did making it. By purchasing the soundtrack you get all 5 main songs found within the game, as well as some bonus tracks!

Thanks to everyone for the continued support.

notes.title: Hotfix 8/9/2021
notes.content:
- Fixed bug where the tab menu would clip the player through the floor.
- Lighting repairs.
- Fixed level 2 and the death plane.

notes.title: Leaderboard Patch
notes.content: Fixed the leaderboard as it did not work with more than 5 unique players.

notes.title: Obscura is now live on Steam!
notes.content: Today's the day! Obscura has been a project we've been passionate about for awhile and to see it published is like a dream come true. We hope you all enjoy the playing game just as much as we did developing it. It's been a long time coming, but with the release on Steam we hope to garner a new audience of people to experience this project. We give a big warm thank you for all the support from anyone throughout this process, and we can't wait to see your favorite parts!
